[b]February 26, 2028: The clock begins to tick[/b]

Following three days of closed doors meetings with Rosenmarkket corporations, private banks, brokers, and legislators the National Bank of Rosenmarkke would release a crucial statement.

The National Bank of Rosenmarkke is fully ready to serve the people of Rosenmarkke and its allies. Under the independent leadership of the NBR it shall be the board of directors goal to ensure economic continuity and stability as the nation moves towards the 6th Republic, 

Following the announcement the national interest rate would be raised to 3.4% with the bank stating a goal of 2.5% inflation by the end of 2028.

On the same day Strømm would issue D-27 which would freeze for 90-days all non-executive spending, including planned infrastructure expansions, non-security discretionary projects, and would devolve estate integration to the local authorities and the already present funding there.

In order to prevent further capital flight and alleviate risk, D-28 would be signed into law allowing businesses in Rosenmarkke with EDU ties and investments to maintain crucial supply chains, and continue trade of limited industrial goods, with no penalty. 

In order to stabilise industry further, the 30% industrial military shift would be lowered by D-31 to 20% of all industrial capacity geared towards military production. 

In a statement following D-31 Strømm would say, Prosperity is around the corner, and the golden era of Rosenmarkke is finally rising,
